project: Kanboard Portfolio Plugin — Code Health & Integration Improvements
description: Event system test coverage, template hook integration, additional core event listeners, auto-complete milestones, and query performance optimization for the Portfolio plugin.

userStories.title: Add event system regression tests
userStories.description: The event listener fix (v1.20.0) replaced $this->on() with $this->dispatcher->addListener() but no test validates that the listeners receive actual TaskEvent data and correctly delegate to DependencyModel. Add regression tests using the existing lightweight test harness.
acceptanceCriteria: Test that task.close listener calls onTaskClosed with the correct task_id from a mock TaskEvent (ArrayAccess-compatible array)
Test that task.open listener calls onTaskOpened with the correct task_id
Test that task_internal_link.create_update listener calls onLinkChanged with the correct task_id
Test that task_internal_link.delete listener calls onLinkChanged with task_id=0 when task_id is absent from the event
Test that portfolio.dependency.resolved event is dispatched when DependencyModel::onTaskClosed detects an unblocked task
Tests use the existing FakeDispatcher + FakeDependencyModel stubs — no running Kanboard instance required
All existing tests continue to pass
PHP lint, PHPCS (0 errors), and PHPStan (level 5) pass
userStories.notes: The FakeDispatcher and lifecycle listener test in ApiRegistrationTest already cover basic registration. This story adds deeper behavioral validation — especially around the DependencyModel event chain and the portfolio.dependency.resolved dispatch.

userStories.title: Add milestone assignment hook on task creation form
userStories.description: Register template:task:form:first-column hook to show a portfolio/milestone dropdown when creating a new task. When the task is created in a project that belongs to one or more portfolios, the user can optionally assign it to a milestone during creation instead of navigating to the milestone detail page afterward.
acceptanceCriteria: Hook registered via $this->template->hook->attachCallable with defensive null checks
When the task's project belongs to zero portfolios, the hook renders nothing (no empty dropdown)
When the task's project belongs to one or more portfolios, renders a dropdown listing all active milestones across those portfolios
Milestone assignment is optional — leaving the dropdown blank creates the task without milestone membership
When a milestone is selected, the task is added to that milestone after task creation via an event listener on task.create
No N+1 queries — milestone list is pre-fetched once per project using PortfolioProjectModel::getPortfolios and MilestoneModel::getByPortfolioId
Template output uses $this->text->e() for all user-visible text and t() for all labels
At least 2 tests: hook renders milestone dropdown when portfolios exist, hook renders nothing when no portfolios
All existing tests pass, PHP lint clean, PHPCS 0 errors, PHPStan clean
userStories.notes: This is the highest-value template hook from Task 1 in the PRD. The task.create event listener must use $this->dispatcher->addListener() (not $this->on()). The milestone assignment uses milestoneTaskModel->add() which validates project-in-portfolio membership.

userStories.title: Add display-only template hooks (portfolio context banner, project badge, board icon)
userStories.description: Register three additional template hooks that surface portfolio context in Kanboard's existing pages: (1) template:task:show:top — portfolio context banner on task detail, (2) template:project:header:after — portfolio membership badge in project header, (3) template:board:task:icons — blocked icon alongside existing footer indicator.
acceptanceCriteria: template:task:show:top renders 'This task is in Portfolio: {name}' banner when the task's project belongs to one or more portfolios, with links to each portfolio dashboard
template:task:show:top renders nothing when the task's project belongs to no portfolios
template:project:header:after renders portfolio membership badge(s) with links to portfolio dashboards
template:project:header:after renders nothing when the project belongs to no portfolios
template:board:task:icons renders a blocked icon (🔴) using the existing PortfolioHelper::isTaskBlocked cache — no additional queries
All hooks use attachCallable with defensive null checks
All output escaped with $this->text->e(), all labels wrapped in t()
CSS classes prefixed with portfolio-
At least 3 tests (one per hook, verifying render-vs-nothing behavior)
All existing tests pass, PHP lint clean, PHPCS 0 errors, PHPStan clean
userStories.notes: The board:task:icons hook reuses PortfolioHelper's per-project lazy cache (same pattern as the existing board:task:footer blocked indicator). No new queries needed.

userStories.title: Add auto-complete milestones on task column move
userStories.description: Listen to task.move.column event. When a task moves to a column whose name matches 'done' patterns (done, completed, closed, finished, deployed, released), check if all tasks in any of the task's milestones are now closed/in-done-columns. If so, and if portfolio_auto_complete_milestones config is enabled, auto-transition the milestone status to completed (0).
acceptanceCriteria: New config setting portfolio_auto_complete_milestones (integer, default 1) added to ConfigController, settings template, and translations
Event listener registered via $this->dispatcher->addListener('task.move.column', ...) in Plugin.php
Listener is defensive: no-op if task_id is missing, if the task isn't in any milestone, or if config is disabled
Column name matching uses the same done-pattern list as PortfolioViewController::resolveCanonicalLane
When all tasks in a milestone are closed (is_active=0), the milestone status is updated to 0 (completed) via milestoneModel->update()
When not all tasks are closed, no milestone status change occurs
At least 3 tests: auto-complete triggers when last task moves to done column, auto-complete does NOT trigger when config is disabled, auto-complete does NOT trigger when other tasks remain active
All existing tests pass, PHP lint clean, PHPCS 0 errors, PHPStan clean
userStories.notes: The task.move.column event provides task_id in the event data. The handler needs to resolve which milestones contain the task, then check completion status of all tasks in each milestone. Use milestoneTaskModel->getMilestones(taskId) and milestoneTaskModel->getTasks(milestoneId) for this.

userStories.title: Add task.update and task.assignee_change event listeners
userStories.description: Register two additional event listeners: (1) task.update — when date_due or priority changes on a task that's in a portfolio milestone, invalidate any cached critical path data (no-op for now, but provides the hook point). (2) task.assignee_change — when a task is reassigned, log the change for workload recalculation (no-op for now, provides the hook point for future real-time workload updates).
acceptanceCriteria: task.update listener registered via $this->dispatcher->addListener in Plugin.php
task.assignee_change listener registered via $this->dispatcher->addListener in Plugin.php
Both listeners are defensive: no-op if task_id is missing or if the task isn't in any portfolio
task.update listener calls a new DependencyModel::onTaskUpdated(int $taskId) method (currently a no-op stub that returns early)
task.assignee_change listener calls a new PortfolioTaskModel::onAssigneeChanged(int $taskId) method (currently a no-op stub)
Both stub methods are documented with TODOs explaining their future purpose
FakeDispatcher in test harness captures these listeners
At least 2 tests: verify listeners are registered and delegate to the correct model methods with correct task_id
All existing tests pass, PHP lint clean, PHPCS 0 errors, PHPStan clean
userStories.notes: These are stub listeners that provide hook points for future features. US-004 establishes the pattern for column-move event handling; this story follows the same pattern. The stubs ensure that when real functionality is added later, the event wiring is already in place and tested.

userStories.title: Optimize PortfolioTaskModel query scoping
userStories.description: Replace the full-table scan in PortfolioTaskModel::buildFilteredTaskRows() with a project-scoped query. Currently calls $this->db->table('tasks')->findAll() which loads ALL tasks in the database. Change to $this->db->table('tasks')->in('project_id', $projectIds)->findAll() where $projectIds comes from the existing getPortfolioProjectIds() call.
acceptanceCriteria: buildFilteredTaskRows() uses ->in('project_id', $projectIds) to scope the initial task query to portfolio projects only
The same project scoping is applied to buildTaskDependencyStats() — only fetch task_has_links rows where task_id is in the scoped task set
buildTableLookup() for 'projects', 'columns', and 'users' is unchanged (these are small reference tables)
All existing PortfolioTaskModelTest tests pass unchanged — behavior is identical, just fewer rows scanned
If $projectIds is empty, return early with [] (existing behavior preserved)
PicoDb ->in() is used (not raw SQL) for cross-driver compatibility
PHP lint clean, PHPCS 0 errors, PHPStan clean
userStories.notes: This is a performance optimization, not a behavior change. All existing tests should pass without modification. The ->in() clause generates standard SQL IN (...) which works identically on SQLite, MySQL, and PostgreSQL. For empty $projectIds arrays, PicoDb's ->in() generates IN (NULL) which matches nothing — the early return guard handles this case explicitly.

userStories.title: Optimize DependencyModel query scoping
userStories.description: Replace the full-table scan in DependencyModel::getDependencies() with a project-scoped query. Currently calls $this->db->table('task_has_links')->findAll() which loads ALL link rows. Change to fetch only links where task_id belongs to a task in one of the portfolio's projects.
acceptanceCriteria: getDependencies() fetches task IDs from portfolio projects first, then queries task_has_links with ->in('task_id', $portfolioTaskIds)
If no tasks exist in the portfolio's projects, return early with [] (existing behavior preserved)
The $portfolioTaskIds set is computed from $this->db->table('tasks')->in('project_id', $projectIds)->findAll() scoped to portfolio projects
All existing DependencyModelTest tests pass unchanged — behavior is identical, fewer rows scanned
PicoDb ->in() is used (not raw SQL) for cross-driver compatibility
If $portfolioTaskIds exceeds a reasonable threshold (e.g., 1000), fall back to the full-table scan to avoid overly large IN clauses (document the threshold in a comment)
PHP lint clean, PHPCS 0 errors, PHPStan clean
userStories.notes: Same pattern as US-006 but for the DependencyModel. The fallback threshold for large IN clauses prevents issues with SQLite's SQLITE_MAX_VARIABLE_NUMBER limit (default 999). For portfolios with >1000 tasks, the full-table scan is acceptable since the in-memory filtering is already fast enough.
